name: towbar
description: Opinionated, source-driven deployments to Ubuntu servers you own.
author: Avgeek, Inc.

scripts.cli:check: node tools/build-towbar-cli.mjs --check && node --test tools/build-towbar-cli.test.mjs && bash tools/test-towbar-cli.sh
scripts.docs:api: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=towbar-api && pnpm --filter towbar-api exec tsx scripts/export-responses.ts && pnpm --filter towbar-api exec tsx scripts/export-api.ts
scripts.docs:check: pnpm --filter towbar-docs check && node tools/generate-use-case-docs.mjs --check && node tools/sync-docs.mjs --check && node tools/check-docs.mjs
scripts.docs:examples:check: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=@workspace/towbar-deployer && node tools/check-documentation-examples.mjs
scripts.verify: pnpm repository:check && pnpm repository:test && pnpm distribution:test && pnpm cli:check && pnpm config:check && pnpm docs:check && pnpm docs:examples:check && pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:verification-runner && pnpm test:examples && pnpm test && pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=moderate && pnpm build
scripts.docs:api:check: pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=towbar-api && pnpm --filter towbar-api exec tsx scripts/export-responses.ts --check && pnpm --filter towbar-api exec tsx scripts/export-api.ts --check
